abilities.name: Klonk
abilities.effect: Klonk is a token. You can re-roll forgin' rolls for this unit while this unit's Klonk is on the battlefield. If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove this unit's Klonk from the battlefield after the Attack ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

abilities.name: Power of da Great Green God
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Ironjawz Infantry unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a forgin' roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is armed with Grunta-tongs. On a 4+, the target's melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Ward-smashing Choppa
abilities.effect: If an attack made with this unit's Ward-smashing Choppa scores a hit, the target has the Ward‑smashed keyword for the rest of the battle. Ward rolls cannot be made for a Ward‑smashed unit even if this unit has been destroyed.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 1" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a shield bash roll of D6 for each model in this unit that is within 3" of the target. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Berserkers
abilities.effect: This unit can use a Run ability and still use Charge abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: Unleashed Rage
abilities.effect: This unit has Strike-first if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: You Messin'?
abilities.effect: Enemy units with a Health characteristic of 1 or 2 cannot contest objectives while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: You Call Dat A Punch?
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an Attack ability that targeted this unit
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Gore-grunta Charge
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Add 1 to the mortal damage inflicted (if any) if the target is Cavalry.

abilities.name: Barge Through
abilities.effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy Infantry units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy Infantry units, but it cannot end the move in combat unless specified in the ability used.

abilities.name: Dead 'Ard
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: Flattened into the Mud
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice and add the number of momentum points this unit has to the roll. On a 5+, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Momentum
abilities.effect: Each time this unit has charged as a result of using a Charge ability, it gains 1 momentum point. Each time it uses a Run ability, it gains 2 momentum points. It can have a maximum of 3 momentum points at once. Add the number of momentum points this unit has to the Damage characteristic of its Maw-grunta's Tusks. At the end of each battle round, subtract 1 from its momentum points, to a minimum of 0.

abilities.name: Carve a Path
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick each enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this unit gains 2 momentum points.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Momentum
abilities.effect: Each time this unit has charged as a result of using a Charge ability, it gains 1 momentum point. Each time it uses a Run ability, it gains 2 momentum points. It can have a maximum of 3 momentum points at once. Add the number of momentum points this unit has to the Damage characteristic of its Maw-grunta's Tusks. At the end of each battle round, subtract 1 from its momentum points, to a minimum of 0.

abilities.name: In Their Element
abilities.effect: The first time an enemy Monster is destroyed by this unit, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's attacks for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Berserkers
abilities.effect: This unit can use a Run ability and still use Charge abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: Propa Wonky
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a friendly Ironjawz unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Alright, Get 'Em
abilities.effect: If a friendly Ironjawz unit uses the 'Counter-charge' command while it is wholly within 12" of this unit, spend 1 command point to use that command instead of 2.

abilities.name: Hunt and Crush
abilities.effect: Friendly Ironjawz units can pile in 2D6" instead of 3" while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Rousing Ruckus
abilities.effect: Each time you make a chanting roll for this unit, add 1 to the roll for each other friendly Ironjawz unit within this unit's combat range.

abilities.name: Extremely Loud
abilities.effect: Enemy Heroes cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: A Knack for Killin'
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this unit's combat attacks.

abilities.name: Monsta-killa
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Monster in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1, nothing happens. On a 2-5, inflict D6 mortal damage on the target. On a 6, inflict 2D6 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Obsessed With Violence
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks while it is in combat. Add 1 to this unit's Move characteristic while it is not in combat.

abilities.name: Pig-headed
abilities.effect: This unit cannot use Retreat abilities.

abilities.name: Clumsy Rider
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Companion melee weapons.

abilities.name: Roaring Bully
abilities.effect: This unit cannot contest objectives that are being contested by enemy Unique Heroes.

abilities.name: Far Too Eager
abilities.effect: In your charge phase, if this unit is not in combat and there are any enemy units within 12" of this unit, this unit must use the 'Charge' ability.

abilities.name: Scarred 'Un
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points:

abilities.name: Mean 'Un
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy Infantry unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Loud 'Un
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

abilities.name: Weird 'Un
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a Spell ability
abilities.effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per Spell ability.

abilities.name: Smelly 'Un
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target this unit if it has not charged this turn.

abilities.effect: Add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.
